description: Defines the CodeIndexConfigManager class responsible for managing configuration state, validation, and restart logic for a code indexing feature, including loading from global state, handling secrets, and determining configuration changes.

classes.name: CodeIndexConfigManager
classes.description: Manages configuration state, validation, and restart logic for code indexing, including loading configuration, checking if configured, and detecting critical changes.

methods.name: setKiloOrgProps
methods.description: Sets Kilo organization properties for cloud-based indexing.

methods.name: getKiloOrgProps
methods.description: Retrieves Kilo organization properties.

methods.name: isKiloOrgMode
methods.description: Checks if Kilo org mode is available with valid credentials.

methods.name: getContextProxy
methods.description: Returns the ContextProxy instance.

methods.name: _loadAndSetConfiguration
methods.description: Loads configuration from storage and updates instance variables.

methods.name: loadConfiguration
methods.description: Loads persisted configuration, refreshes secrets, updates state, and determines if restart is needed.

methods.name: isConfigured
methods.description: Checks if the service is properly configured based on current settings.

methods.name: doesConfigChangeRequireRestart
methods.description: Determines if a configuration change requires restarting the indexing process.

methods.name: _hasVectorDimensionChanged
methods.description: Checks if model changes result in vector dimension changes requiring restart.

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Returns the current configuration snapshot.

methods.name: isFeatureEnabled
methods.description: Indicates if the code indexing feature is enabled.

methods.name: isFeatureConfigured
methods.description: Indicates if the feature is properly configured.

methods.name: currentEmbedderProvider
methods.description: Returns the current embedder type.

methods.name: qdrantConfig
methods.description: Returns current Qdrant URL and API key.

methods.name: currentModelId
methods.description: Returns the current model ID used for embeddings.

methods.name: currentModelDimension
methods.description: Returns the current model dimension, considering built-in and custom dimensions.

methods.name: currentSearchMinScore
methods.description: Returns the minimum search score threshold.

methods.name: currentSearchMaxResults
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of search results.

methods.name: currentEmbeddingBatchSize
methods.description: Returns the configured embedding batch size.

methods.name: currentScannerMaxBatchRetries
methods.description: Returns the configured scanner max batch retries.
